$comment: Machine-usable Reading question templates derived from ReadingStructureService + ReadingAnswerSheetBuilder. Practice-only types must stay Draft and are not publishable.

MatchingTextReference.notes: Single letter A-D. Empty options fall back to Part A texts A-D in the exam player.

ShortAnswer.notes: CorrectAnswerJson is a JSON string. Synonyms are a string array and only mark if policy ShortAnswerAcceptSynonyms is on.

SentenceCompletion.notes: Same payload as ShortAnswer. Player renders a text box.

MultipleChoice3.notes: Exactly 3 options. Answer is a letter, not option text.

MultipleChoice4.notes: Exactly 4 options. Internal 1-16; public numbers are +6.

textLinkRules.pdfOnly: Each part must include texts: []. This is the official exam-player shape.
textLinkRules.partA: If any question has readingTextDisplayOrder, every Part A question must have one.
textLinkRules.partB: If texts are present: 6 texts and readingTextDisplayOrder must yield 1 question per text.
textLinkRules.partC: If texts are present: 2 texts and readingTextDisplayOrder must yield 8 questions per text (1-8 -> 1, 9-16 -> 2).

requiredPublishFields: evidenceSentence (required on the paper; NOT imported from the current C# manifest)
primary QuestionPaper asset per part A/B/C
